description_en: You can modify the authorization rules for an instance group
description_zh: 修改实例组的授权规则
kebab_example: aliyun iotcc update-group-authorization-rule-attribute --iot-cloud-connector-group-id iotccg-g00epppbi9di9y0000 --authorization-rule-id gar-ez91t41jvi6tr80000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateGroupAuthorizationRuleAttribute

parameters.help_en: The ID of the IoT Cloud Connector group
parameters.name: iot_cloud_connector_group_id

parameters.help_en:
A description of the authorization rule.

The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length. It must start with a letter or a Chinese character. It cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
授权规则的描述信息。

长度为2~256个字符，必须以字母或中文开头，但不能以`http://` 或`https://`开头
parameters.name: authorization_rule_description

parameters.help_en:
The name of the authorization rule.

The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length. It must start with a letter or a Chinese character. It can contain letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh:
授权规则的名称。

名称长度为2~128个字符，以大小写字母或中文开头，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）
parameters.name: authorization_rule_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the authorization rule to update
parameters.name: authorization_rule_id

parameters.help_en: The source CIDR blocks. Valid values of N: 1 to 20
parameters.name: source_cidrs

parameters.help_en:
The type of destination. Valid values:

Cidr: A CIDR block.

Domain: A domain name
parameters.help_zh:
访问目标类型。取值：
Cidr：CIDR地址块。
Domain：域名
parameters.name: destination_type

parameters.help_en:
The destination port range. Valid values:

TCP or UDP: 1 to 65535. Use a forward slash (/) to separate the start port from the end port. Example: 1/200.

ICMP: -1/-1.

ALL: -1/-1
parameters.help_zh:
目标端口范围。取值范围：

TCP、UDP协议：1~65535。使用正斜线（/）隔开起始端口和终止端口。例如：1/200。
ICMP协议：-1/-1。
ALL：-1/-1
parameters.name: destination_port

parameters.help_en:
The protocol type. Valid values:

tcp.

udp.

icmp.

all: All protocols
parameters.help_zh:
协议类型。取值：

tcp。
udp。
icmp。
all：支持所有协议
parameters.name: protocol

parameters.help_en:
The access policy. Valid values:

Permit: Allow access.

Deny: Deny access
parameters.help_zh:
访问策略。取值：

Permit：允许。

Deny：拒绝
parameters.name: policy

parameters.help_en:
A client token that ensures the idempotence of the request.

You must generate a unique value for this parameter. The value can be up to 64 ASCII characters in length.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may differ for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform only a dry run. Valid values:

true: Perform a check. The authorization rule is not updated. The system checks required parameters, request format, and business limits. If the check fails, an error is returned. If the check passes, the error code `DryRunOperation` is returned.

false (default): Perform the operation. After the check passes, the system returns an HTTP 2xx status code and updates the authorization rule
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会修改实例组的授权规则。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接进行操作
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the IoT Cloud Connector group.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
实例组所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

AuthorizationRuleId.description_en: The ID of the authorization rule
